patterns.note: High-contrast color blocking with full-width sections alternating between stark white, vibrant blue, and dark gray backgrounds.
Impactful, oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for primary calls to action and section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy.
A horizontal scroll carousel is used for a list of feature ideas, allowing users to explore multiple items within a compact space.
The main logo in the hero section shrinks and sticks to the top-center of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The final call-to-action section features a conversational, chat-like UI with message bubbles and an embedded interactive graphic.

technique_notes: Sections are defined by full-viewport-width solid color backgrounds, creating distinct visual blocks that guide the user's eye down the page.
Typography uses a strong hierarchy with extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif fonts for headlines to create immediate impact, paired with a more subdued, readable sans-serif for body text.

The header logo dynamically scales down and fixes its position to the top of the viewport as the user scrolls past the initial hero content, maintaining a persistent, minimal brand presence. This effect likely leverages GSAP ScrollTrigger.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards, more rounded for chat bubbles.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and main content sections, dense within the horizontal scroll card grid.

standout: The bold, high-contrast color palette combined with oversized, impactful typography creates a striking visual identity. The playful, interactive chat-like UI at the bottom of the page is also a distinctive and engaging element.
